T~eSBqHUt@WRzqG6GdtM.text:
Rules:
Make sure to follow the rules! If you break one, it will lower your score. And be careful with Golden Rule (GR)! Make sure you follow the rules so that Whirlpool Chan will be able to rate them. Otherwise, your remix is likely to be ignored by @pearceandhero

1. No Google images, stolen OCs, copyright & bitmap OC's.
2. Don't break the Scratch Community Guidelines.
3. Don't change the sprites, backdrop, costumes and music outside of "OC" sprite.
4. Don't delete anything. (GR)
5. No recolors. (GR)
6. Don't steal my Rating Room.
7. Don't be angry at me when I give you a lower rating. (GR)
8. Don't remix when Rating Room is closed.
9. Only 1 OC at the time.
10. DON'T ruin and raid the project... (GR)
